name: wechaty-getting-started
description: Wechaty conversational SDK getting start template & examples

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:md
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:unit:deno: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI="${CI:-}" NODE_BINARY="${NODE_BINARY:-$(command -v node)}" deno test --no-check --allow-read=.,/tmp,/etc/alpine-release --allow-write=/tmp --allow-env --allow-net --allow-run --allow-sys=hostname,cpus,networkInterfaces --allow-ffi=node_modules/leveldown/prebuilds,node_modules/wechaty-puppet-neo/native tests

author: Huan LI <zixia@zixia.net>
